hook.text: Bitcoin has no central server. Ten thousand nodes maintain the same ledger. No authority, no single point of failure.

buildup.text: Decentralized networks distribute control across all participants. Consensus replaces central authority.

discovery.text: The cost is efficiency: Bitcoin processes 7 transactions per second. Visa handles 65,000. Decentralization has overhead.

twist.text: The CAP theorem proves you can't have consistency, availability, and partition tolerance simultaneously. Pick two.

climax.text: Decentralized networks trade throughput for trust. No middleman means no dependency—but also no efficiency gains.

punchline.text: No center, no single failure. Decentralization trades speed for trust.

quiz.question: What tradeoff do decentralized networks make?
